title: Locked Decision ADR and Configuration Authority
negative_results: A locked decision cannot be changed: refuse_change() routes through claims.refuse_post_output_retuning and raises R1082ClaimError.
The ConfigurationAuthority is a frozen dataclass; attribute assignment raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError (no in-place edit path for the UI).
A fixture that silently drifts from the ADR (e.g. root_feature changed) is rejected by validate() with ConfigAuthorityError.
Unknown decision keys are rejected rather than silently accepted.

claims.statement: The fifteen operator-selected EARTH_ROOT_D_V1 decisions are encoded as an immutable, versioned, deterministically hashed ADR-in-code and validated against the public fixture.
Changing any locked decision changes freeze_hash() and therefore mints a new profile id, invalidating prior-holdout comparison.

privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public fixtures only, no private inputs
